details: Bitcoin (BTC) has recently climbed above $85,000, reaching its highest levels since late January, with a 24-hour increase of over 5%. This rally is largely attributed to a broader "risk-on" sentiment in the market, renewed regulatory optimism, and robust institutional demand, as indicated by significant inflows into US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs).
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $85,000 Amid Bullish Market Shifts

details: Ethereum (ETH) has demonstrated strong performance, breaking above the $2,700 mark with a 24-hour increase of 5-7%. The upward momentum is supported by rising institutional engagement, a significant drop in average gas fees to historical lows, and an increase in stablecoin transfers on the network. Analysts suggest that traders are now looking towards the $3,000 level as a key resistance point.
title: Ethereum Breaks $2,700, Traders Target $3,000 Amid Ecosystem Growth

details: The Arbitrum (ARB) token experienced a notable surge of over 27% in the past 24 hours, reaching $0.22. This impressive jump follows a bullish research note from Standard Chartered, which projected that ARB could hit $10 by the end of 2030. The bank's optimistic outlook is based on improved economic metrics driven by the Robinhood Chain and Arbitrum's Orbit ecosystem.
title: Arbitrum Jumps Over 27% on Standard Chartered's $10 Price Target

details: Monero (XMR) recently witnessed significant volatility, initially surging by 11-13% to reach prices between $575 and $588, fueled by a broader crypto market rally and a rotation into privacy-focused digital assets. However, this surge was quickly followed by profit-taking, leading to an 8-11% drop in the last 24 hours, with its price now hovering around $520. The $500 mark is considered a critical support level for the cryptocurrency.
title: Monero Sees Sharp Rally and Subsequent Profit-Taking
